Mature dataset reduces uncertainty on durability of benefit.
22.6% chemo arm got ADC later

This is late-stage confirmation of efficacy and safety for sac-TMT in a key NSCLC setting, building on prior PFS and China approval. A larger catalyst would be regulatory wins ex-China via MSD’s global Phase IIIs or NRDL expansions driving wider uptake.
